description: Real boto3 backend for the container. Rewrite container/app.py to persist orders to DynamoDB (coffee-ship-orders), read the loyalty rate from SSM (cached ~60s, fallback 10), compute points = floor(total)*rate, derive order status from a PURE status_for(created_at, now) function (RECEIVED <10s / BREWING 10-25s / READY >=25s), and expose POST /order, GET /order/{id} (and ?id=), GET /orders (Scan + sort desc + top 10). Keep /health and ALL SPA static serving intact; bump APP_VERSION to v3-realapp. Add boto3 to requirements.txt and pip-install it in the Dockerfile python stage. Add a status_for unit test. This is the dependency root: it defines the API shape FEAT-003 consumes. Region ap-southeast-1 via env with that default.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/plan.md and .agents/tasks/context.json FIRST; context.json replaces re-exploration.

Edit /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/requirements.txt: add a pinned boto3 line (e.g. boto3==1.34.162 or a known-good 1.x pin). This is the ONLY new dependency.

Edit /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/Dockerfile: in the python:3.12-slim runtime stage, after 'COPY requirements.txt ./' add 'RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt'. Keep the node build stage, COPY app.py, COPY --from=build dist, COPY architecture.svg into /app/static, ENV PORT=8080, EXPOSE 8080, CMD ["python","app.py"].

Rewrite /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/app.py: guard the boto3 import in try/except at module load and create DynamoDB/SSM clients lazily (region from AWS_DEFAULT_REGION/AWS_REGION, default ap-southeast-1) so py_compile and /health work with no boto3/AWS. Config via env: ORDERS_TABLE_NAME (default coffee-ship-orders), loyalty SSM param name (default /coffee-ship/loyalty/points-per-dollar).
Implement the PURE function status_for(created_at, now) -> 'RECEIVED' if elapsed < 10, 'BREWING' if < 25, else 'READY'. Keep it free of AWS/IO so it is unit-testable.
Implement loyalty rate lookup from SSM with a module-level ~60s TTL cache ((value, fetched_at)); on ClientError or missing param, fall back to 10. points = int(float(total)) * rate.

POST /order: accept {items:[{id,name,qty,price}],total} OR {orderId,total}; generate orderId if absent; put_item with orderId (PK), createdAt, total, points, items? and status RECEIVED; return {orderId,status,points,total,createdAt}. On bad input -> JSON 400; on ClientError -> JSON 500 logged to stdout; never crash.
GET /order/{id} and GET /order?id=: get_item, recompute status_for, return the order or JSON 404 if missing. Keep a browsable sample for GET /order with no id if convenient.
GET /orders: Scan the table, sort by createdAt desc, take 10, recompute status_for for each, return {orders,count}. Add a comment that Scan is acceptable at demo scale.

KEEP GET /health -> {"status":"ok","version":APP_VERSION} returning 200 even when DynamoDB is unreachable. KEEP all SPA static serving: GET / -> index.html text/html 200, /assets/* with mimetypes, /architecture.svg -> image/svg+xml, SPA fallback for unknown non-asset paths, 404 for missing asset-looking paths, and the path-traversal guard.

Add /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/test_app.py: import app with boto3 guarded, assert status_for RECEIVED at ~5s, BREWING at ~15s, READY at ~30s. Write it to run under pytest; if pytest is absent it must also work via 'python3 test_app.py' (exit nonzero on failure).
Build to confirm: SPA build (npm install && npm run build) then docker build of container/ to exercise the new pip install.
Commit locally on branch coffee-ship-realapp (git -C /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp add + commit). NEVER push.
Set this FEAT status to completed and record in findings the exact JSON shapes of POST /order, GET /order/{id}, and GET /orders responses (field names) so FEAT-003 can match them.

findings:
Implemented in container/app.py (APP_VERSION='v3-realapp'). boto3==1.34.162 pinned in container/requirements.txt and installed via 'RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt' in the Dockerfile python:3.12-slim stage. boto3 import is guarded (module-level try/except; ClientError/BotoCoreError fallback classes defined) and DynamoDB/SSM clients are created lazily, so py_compile and GET /health work with no boto3/AWS. Region: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION||AWS_REGION||'ap-southeast-1'. Table: env ORDERS_TABLE_NAME default 'coffee-ship-orders' (PK orderId). Loyalty: env LOYALTY_PARAM_NAME default '/coffee-ship/loyalty/points-per-dollar', get_loyalty_rate() caches ~60s (module-level (rate,fetched_at)), falls back to 10 on any error. points=int(float(total))*rate. status_for(created_at, now) is PURE: RECEIVED <10s, BREWING 10-25s (>=10 and <25), READY >=25s. Stored DynamoDB record fields: orderId, createdAt (int epoch seconds), total (string), points (int), status ('RECEIVED'), items? (list of {id,name,qty,price}). GET /orders uses Scan + in-memory sort by createdAt desc, top 10 (demo-scale comment present). Status is always recomputed from createdAt on read.

EXACT API RESPONSE SHAPES (field names) for FEAT-003 to match:
- POST /order (body: {items:[{id,name,qty,price}], total} OR {orderId, total}; orderId generated if absent) -> 200 JSON object: {"orderId": string, "status": string (RECEIVED|BREWING|READY), "points": int, "total": number (float), "createdAt": int (epoch seconds)}. Bad input -> 400 {"error": string}. AWS failure -> 500 {"error": string}. (Note: POST response does NOT echo items.)
- GET /order/{id} and GET /order?id=... -> 200 JSON object: {"orderId": string, "status": string, "points": int, "total": number, "createdAt": int, "items": [...] (present only if the stored order had items)}. Missing -> 404 {"error": "order not found"}. AWS failure -> 500 {"error": string}. GET /order with no id -> 200 browsable sample object with the same order fields (orderId='sample-order').
- GET /orders -> 200 JSON object: {"orders": [ <order object as in GET /order/{id}> ], "count": int}. Newest first (sorted by createdAt desc), max 10. AWS failure -> 500 {"error": "could not list orders"}.
- GET /health -> 200 {"status": "ok", "version": "v3-realapp"} (always 200, even with no AWS).

Unit test container/test_app.py (status_for RECEIVED@5s/BREWING@15s/READY@30s + boundaries + compute_points) runs under pytest and standalone 'python3 test_app.py'. Verification run: py_compile OK (and OK with boto3 hidden), 4 tests passed, SPA npm install+build OK (dist/ produced), docker build of container/ OK (boto3 pip-installed) then test image removed, runtime curl smoke OK (/ 200 text/html, /health 200 v3-realapp, /architecture.svg 200 image/svg+xml, /nope.js 404, /spa/route 200 text/html, /orders 500 w/o AWS with no crash, server stayed alive). Note: /architecture.svg is served from STATIC_DIR; it is baked by the Dockerfile from container/architecture.svg (regenerated by FEAT-006). dist/ is gitignored and not committed.
